type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] (P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) {r : σ → ℕ},
  (∀ (j : σ), MvPolynomial.degreeOf j P ≤ r j) →
    ∀ {B : ℝ},
      (∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), |↑(P.coeff d)| ≤ B) →
        ∀ (x : σ → ℝ), |(MvPolynomial.eval x) ((MvPolynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) P)| ≤ B * ∏ j, (1 + |x j|) ^ r j
type_provenance: Full actual native #check @Roth.abs_eval_le, clean receipt, standard axioms
what: An integer multivariate polynomial with common absolute coefficient bound B and coordinate degrees at most r has value at x at most B times the product of (1+|x_j|)^r_j.
how: Expand evaluation, take the finite-sum triangle inequality, enlarge support to Roth.box using monomial_le_degreeOf and Roth.mem_box, and apply private Roth.sum_box_prod_pow_le_aux to factor the geometric majorant.
hypotheses: A finite variable type, an integer polynomial, coordinate natural degree bounds, a common real absolute coefficient bound, and any real evaluation point; B≥0 follows from hB at zero.

caller_summary.canonical_audit: 293 requested, unique, present and values; the same sole direct proof consumer

mathlib_api_audit: Prefer eval₂ and existing size-hom classes. AbsoluteValue.eval_mvPolynomial_le is a homogeneous/coefficient-l1/sup bound, not the rectangular common-coefficient bound. GaussNorm estimates concern weighted coefficient suprema, not arbitrary real evaluation.
moral_duplications: No duplicate: abs_coeff_diag_le handles coefficient collisions; normOne_le_card_mul is unweighted; Main.abs_eval_lt_of_le_index is a Taylor/index estimate. A future weighted-support majorant can share proof stages with the homogeneous bound.
generalization: Verified strongest primary form: arbitrary CommSemiring R coefficients, CommSemiring S evaluation, ordered CommSemiring T output with PartialOrder and IsOrderedRing, FunLike F S T and existing Zero/Nonneg/Subadditive/Submultiplicative hom classes. Original ℤ/ℝ map input and full private caller specialize cleanly. No unit-size bound, injectivity, domain, total order, strict order or negation premise.
missing_api: Nonhomogeneous rectangular coordinate-degree polynomial evaluation majorant; generic geometric-sum bound from declaration96 is a separate new prerequisite.
junk: Not junk: live main-lemma dependency and nontrivial finite weighted-support reasoning.
action: YES-but-generalise-first (MODERN-IDIOM); contribute a generic size-hom eval₂ theorem in Mathlib/Analysis/Polynomial/MvPolynomial.lean, then specialize the sole project caller.
